title: Export SRT Subtitles on iPhone for an Editable Caption Track
description: Export SRT when you need subtitles as an editable timed-text file separate from the video.
direct: Export SRT when you need subtitles as an editable timed-text file separate from the video. Generate captions, correct the words and timing, then save the SRT with its matching video. Export a captioned MP4 or MOV when you need the text permanently visible instead.

cards.choice.heading: SRT is a sidecar
cards.choice.body: An SRT contains caption text and start/end times. It does not contain your video. YouTube supports basic UTF-8 SRT but does not recognize styling markup, so do not expect animated word highlights to transfer.
sections.explain.heading: Check synchronization after editing
sections.explain.body: A subtitle file can be correct for one cut and wrong for another. Removing an introduction, changing playback speed or moving a scene can shift later captions. Keep a clear shared filename for the video and subtitle version. Check several points through a long clip rather than only the first line.
sections.practice.heading: Choose the right export
sections.practice.body: Our app offers SRT text and captioned MP4/MOV exports. Core caption generation can run on device; optional online AI text tools require consent. A separate SRT lets the destination render captions, while a captioned video carries their visible appearance. Free single-video exports include a Just Captions watermark; Pro unlocks further features. Space Sheep Studio develops the app. This is caption creation from speech, not removal or extraction of already burned-in text.

steps.step-1.text: Import the spoken video into Subtitle Maker: Just Captions and generate captions on iPhone.
steps.step-2.text: Review names, punctuation and timing against the video. Complete any video trims before the final caption check.
steps.step-3.text: Choose SRT export and save the file beside the matching video. Import both into the receiving editor or platform and preview the beginning and end.
